features.label: From vehicle in to delivery
features.lead: Keep your daily jobs together, with optional modules for outside vendors, dealership work and franchise networks.

items.title: Customers and vehicles
items.description: Keep customer and vehicle records together with the jobs you create for them.

items.title: Job cards
items.description: Track work from draft and in progress through quality check, ready and delivered. Keep services and job status in the job card.

items.title: Billing and invoices
items.description: Create GST and cash invoices with your business details, service lines and totals.

items.title: Payments
items.description: Record payments and review collections and outstanding invoice balances.

items.title: Staff and attendance
items.description: Maintain your staff directory and record attendance. Add the Staff advances & salary module for advances and salary workflows.

items.title: Reports and exports
items.description: Review sales, collections and outstanding balances, and export reports to Excel. Additional report access depends on your modules and permissions.

items.question: How does licensing work?
items.answer: Each user needs a licence for Windows, Android or both. See the pricing page for current options.

items.question: Is a trial available?
items.answer: Check the signup page for current trial availability, eligibility and duration.

items.question: Can I add users later?
items.answer: The Owner can manage the subscription inside the app; available changes and charges are shown there.

items.question: How do I pay?
items.answer: Follow the payment options shown during signup, or contact Trovo for assistance.

items.question: Where do I sign in?
items.answer: Install Baylior on Windows or Android, register with your codes and sign in inside the app.

items.question: What about privacy?
items.answer: Read the Privacy Policy for how information is handled.

items.question: How can I get help?
items.answer: Contact Trovo Tech Solutions on +91 90426 72148 or info@trovotechsolutions.in.
